The scene resembles a protest with localized enforcement, not a riot.

The interaction (e.g., f11–f12) shows physical restraint during a struggle, but the civilian is not clearly helpless nor is the officer acting unilaterally against a passive victim; both parties are engaged, so it does not meet the Abuse definition (aggression against a helpless victim).
